children: Forgent reported fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue of $478.6 million, up 69% year over year, and net income of $54.8 million. Adjusted EBITDA was $104.9 million, while adjusted EPS was $0.24. The company raised its full-year fiscal 2027 guidance for revenue, Adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EPS.
Revenue was $478.6 million, an increase of 69% year over year.
Net income was $54.8 million, with an 11.5% net income margin.
Adjusted EBITDA was $104.9 million; diluted EPS was $0.18 and adjusted EPS was $0.24.
Strong execution on the production ramp drove higher throughput and improved cost absorption, helping first-quarter results exceed the high end of company guidance.
Backlog fully covers the company’s fiscal 2027 guidance, supporting its raised full-year outlook.

Forgent reported gaining traction with multiple frontier AI labs and hyperscalers through its direct sales strategy, with orders from these customers expected to build through fiscal 2027 and into fiscal 2028.
With much of its new manufacturing capacity online, the company is focusing on process standardization, productivity, sourcing discipline and consistent execution.
Amy Ard was promoted to Chief Financial Officer; Juan Macias serves as President of Solutions & Services and Jamie Brown as President of Transformers.
